verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਅਬਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਬਰਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਪਂਾਚ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਨ ਦਰਸ ਅਦਰਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhubidhaa nivaar abaran hui baran bikhai pa(n)aach parapa(n)ch na dharas adharas hai ||

en.bdb: By perpetual meditation on Lord's name, a Guru-conscious person distances himself from duality and caste discrimination. He frees himself from the grip of five vices (lust, anger, greed, ego and attachment) nor does he entangle himself in the rationales or reasoning of philosophies.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਪਾਰਸ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਭਏ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਤ ਆਪਾ ਅਪਰਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: param paaras gur paras paaras bhe kanik anik dhaat aapaa aparas hai ||

en.bdb: Just as an iron piece when touched with a philosopher-stone becomes gold, similarly a devotee meeting Guru becomes a pious and a clean man.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਦੁਆਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਸਨ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਮੈ ਨਿਝਰ ਝਰਨਿ ਰੁਚਤ ਨ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: nav dhuaar paar brahamaasan si(n)ghaasan mai nijhar jharan ruchat na an ras hai ||

en.bdb: Overcoming the pleasures of the nine doors of the body, he rests his faculties in the tenth door, where the divine elixir flows perpetually that turn him away from all other pleasures.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬੀਸ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਈਸ ਅਨਹਦ ਗਦ ਗਦ ਅਭਰ ਭਰਸ ਹੈ ॥੩੨॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh sa(n)dh mile bees ik iees iees anahadh gadh gadh abhar bharas hai ||32||

en.bdb: Be assured that the meeting of Guru and a disciple, makes a disciple realise Lord and virtually becomes like Him. His  heart then remains immersed in the celestial music. (32)
